arena.fountain_park.name: The Park Fountain
arena.fountain_park.rule: The fountain first erupts 5 s into the battle, then [b]every 9 s[/b]: seven arcs of fire land on the scorch marks around it. Anything they hit, [b]friend or foe[/b], takes [color=#ffd36b]80[/color] magic damage, and the scorch marks burn again as ember patches. Pieces right next to the fountain are set alight every second.
arena.tram_stop.name: The Tram Stop
arena.tram_stop.rule: The first tram leaves 6 s into the battle, then [b]one every 13 s[/b]: it charges down the rails across the whole field (the crossing lights come on 3 s ahead). Anything on the track, [b]friend or foe[/b], is knocked aside, takes physical damage equal to [color=#ffd36b]20% of its max health + 120[/color] and 【Burns】 for 4 s.
chapter.ch0.desc: White religious ruins. Broken walls of marble and quartz stretch to the horizon; at the end stands an altar ablaze with rainbow energy crystals.
chapter.ch0.name: Chapter 0: The White Chapter
chapter.ch1_blue.desc: A box garden sealed under a blue dome: a white city of the future, with daylight pouring through the glass and soaking everything in blue. The boss waits beneath the colossal beacon in the north.
chapter.ch1_blue.name: Chapter 1-B: The Blue Chapter
chapter.ch1_green.name: Chapter 1-C: The Green Chapter
chapter.ch1_red.desc: A ruined city burning through the night. Collapsed schools, homes, downtown towers and factories smoulder to the horizon while embers fall like snow. The truck's action points are limited — plan your route.
chapter.ch1_red.name: Chapter 1-A: The Red Chapter
chapter.ch2_cyan.name: Chapter 2-C: The Cyan Chapter
chapter.ch2_purple.desc: A Japanese sky island adrift on a sea of clouds, under a purple night. Nine colossal icy fox tails rise in the north; a giant diagonal sword scar cuts the island in two, crossable only by a few bridges. The boss waits beneath the purple iceberg at the island's heart. Hard ice everywhere; frost on the battlefield piles up 【Chill】 until whoever lingers freezes.
chapter.ch2_purple.name: Chapter 2-A: The Purple Chapter
chapter.ch2_yellow.name: Chapter 2-B: The Yellow Chapter
classrule.amulet: Dual-mode: does different things to allies and enemies.
classrule.bullet: Fixed value: ignores the trigger value; the trigger is just the switch.
classrule.chip: Rewrite: deals no numbers itself, it rewrites the payloads after it in the same firing.
classrule.tome: Learning: grows stronger with every use.
desc.chip_maxhp: rewrites the trigger value of the payloads after it into %s%% of the target's max health
desc.chip_mult: multiplies the trigger value of the payloads after it by ×%s
desc.low_hp_mult: ; ×%s if his health is below %s%% when it triggers
desc.overheal_shield: ; overheal becomes shield (up to %s%% of max health)
desc.scale_missing: (up to +%s%% as its own health drops)
effect.adapt_magazine: load the next magazine for the target
effect.angel_heal: heal 3% of the target's max health
effect.black_keys: kill an ally that hasn't fallen yet and grant Crescendo
effect.blink_strike: teleport and strike repeatedly (1 per 100 trigger value = %s)
effect.blood_rupture: one hit of %s magic damage per second chanted + Fracture
effect.bonus_shots: fire two shots on the spot
effect.brave_legacy: spread the stat boosts she holds to every teammate
effect.charge_scaled_damage: magic damage or healing scaled by charges left
effect.create_field: open a paddy field (+%s per heal on it)
effect.gather_stun: pull the targets together, then stun them
effect.gentle_field: for a while at the start, all damage every unit takes is reduced
effect.health_cost_damage: spend current health to deal %s damage
effect.holy_sword: Holy Sword: slay a common monster outright, or deal %s× its max health as true damage
effect.hp_loss_pct: lose a share of current health
effect.hunter_notes: dodge / damage / penetration against the target
effect.ignite_embers: ignite an ember tile under the target
effect.infusion_pop: Infusion: heal the attacker, hurt the holder
effect.intox_song: give everyone else a stack of Enthralled
effect.lily_cone_heal: spend a Stamen and share the damage out as healing
effect.lily_rebloom: chant Bloom Anew (4 Petals → 1 Stamen per second)
effect.lock_all: magic damage and a stun in the best circular area
effect.medium_wisp: summon a ghost that attacks anyone
effect.money_bag: give a Coin Purse / add coins to it
effect.oath_bestow: grant an oath, max health +50%% of the trigger value (%s)
effect.petrify_wake: end petrification, gain ability power and attack by time
effect.phantom_strike: summon the phantom / it attacks along
effect.quake_slam: smash the ground: cone magic damage + shatter terrain
effect.rainbow_spark: deal %s physical / magic / true-over-time damage at random
effect.selfless_purge: remove normal enemies, cut elite / boss max health
effect.sever: remove a summon / remove max health
effect.starfall_impact: landing: gain a %s shield, enemies in range take half as damage
effect.status_cost_heal: lose a stack and restore health
effect.summon_ghost_behind: summon a ghost behind the target (first hit +%s)
effect.verdant_grove: gain attack speed / restore health by learning count
effect.weather_change: change the battlefield weather by chapter
effect.wild_will: recover 1 health and gain a shield
equip_compat.black: Color: universal, any color can use it.
equip_compat.cyan: Color: cyan, blue, green, white units.
equip_compat.purple: Color: purple, red, blue, white units.
equip_compat.yellow: Color: yellow, red, green, white units.
equipment.amplifier_crossbow.desc: First multiplies the trigger value by 1.6, then deals 60% of it as physical damage (can crit).
equipment.amplifier_crossbow.name: Amplifier Crossbow
equipment.annual_ring_spear.desc: Deals 1× trigger value as physical damage; each use permanently grants +2 defense.
equipment.annual_ring_spear.name: Annual Ring Spear
equipment.basic_bow.name: Wooden Bow
equipment.basic_crossbow.name: Wooden Hand Crossbow
equipment.basic_dual.name: Iron Daggers
equipment.basic_focus.name: Apprentice Grimoire
equipment.basic_heavy.name: Iron Greatsword
equipment.basic_pistols.name: Flintlock Pistols
equipment.basic_polearm.name: Wooden Spear
equipment.basic_rifle.name: Flintlock Rifle
equipment.basic_sword.name: Iron Sword
equipment.black_battlefield.desc: Node Sniper's black sniper rifle (anyone can use it): a long barrel, a heavy muzzle brake and a blue-lensed scope. Its magazine is only 【Stacking 1】 (reload after every shot), but its normal attacks hit very hard (×2.8; rifles ×1.6). +99 attack range, +30 armor penetration; 【Basic】【Crit】: deals trigger value × 50% physical damage to the trigger target.
equipment.black_battlefield.name: Black Battlefield
equipment.black_keys.desc: Node Pianist's piano (anyone can use it): in other hands it's a little piano held on the palm; she plays a black-lacquered, gold-trimmed grand — and when she becomes an angel, it becomes the White Keys. +40 ability power, +1 range; 5 s cooldown 【Eternal】【Stacking 20】: if the trigger target is an ally that hasn't fallen this battle, kills it outright and gives it 1 stack of 【Crescendo】 per 150 trigger value, kept between battles. 【Crescendo】: stacks, can't be dispelled, lasts across battles; each stack speeds the holder's "every few seconds" timers by 3%.
equipment.black_keys.name: Black Keys
equipment.black_mission.desc: Node Commando's black SMG (anyone can use it): a folding stock, a top rail and a long magazine. +15 magic resistance, +15 armor; 2 s cooldown 【Charged 3】: performs a normal attack on the target, then grants the wielder 【Battle Sense】.
equipment.black_mission.name: Black Mission
equipment.blackblade.desc: Node Darkknight's blood-red greatsword (anyone can use it). Grants the trigger target 【Dark Oath】, then raises its max health by 50% of the trigger value; if the target is a summon, also grants 【Light Oath】 and raises max health by another 50% of the trigger value (the added health is restored at once). 【Dark Oath】: doesn't stack, can't be dispelled, permanent. 【Awakening: kill an enemy that killed an ally this battle】: normal-attack interval halved, +100% damage. 【Light Oath】: doesn't stack, can't be dispelled, permanent. 【Awakening: take 20 normal attacks】: when it or its summoner is about to die, restore that one to full health (once each).
equipment.blackblade.name: Blackblade
equipment.blazing_glow.desc: Node Samurai's tachi (anyone can use it), with a black scabbard. +50% attack speed (enough for his drawing flurry to come round within 0.75 s, so the scars keep going). 【Basic】: deals trigger value × 1 physical damage to the trigger target (counts as normal-attack damage). For every time it has already triggered within the last 0.1 s, the multiplier is × 1.05 (a 10-stack scar burst: × 1, 1.05, 1.05² …).
equipment.blazing_glow.name: Blazing Glow
equipment.blessing_heart.desc: Node Sister's rosary (anyone can use it): a string of navy beads with a gold cross set with a sapphire. +30 ability power; 10 s cooldown: if the target has fallen, revives it with 2 × trigger value health (summons too); otherwise heals that much.
equipment.blessing_heart.name: Heart of Blessing
equipment.blight_greatsword.desc: A greatsword of bone-white and moss-green, venom seeping from the cracks in its edge. The wounds don't kill at once; they just never close. +30 attack, +200 health; 【Basic】【Fixed】: the trigger target gains 1 stack of 【Blight】 (4 s, stacks to 8, refreshed on each new stack: 8 magic damage per second per stack).
equipment.blight_greatsword.name: Blightbone Greatsword
equipment.blink_blade.desc: Node Maid's throwing knives (anyone can use them): silver double edges, ruby guards. +40% crit damage, +30 attack. 20 s cooldown 【Charged 2】, with 1 charge ready at the start of battle: the trigger holder teleports (no dash in between) to a spot where she can just reach the trigger target, and enemies that were targeting her pick new targets; she then immediately makes normal attacks against the trigger target — 1 for every 100 trigger value.
equipment.blink_blade.name: Blink Blade
equipment.bubble_blasters.desc: Two red toy bubble guns. A bubble bursts where it lands, and leaves that spot a little tougher. +200 health; 【Basic】: the trigger target heals 35 health and gains a 25-point shield.
equipment.bubble_blasters.name: Bubble Blasters
equipment.butterfly.desc: Node Angel's pair of pistols (anyone can use them): white in the right hand, black in the left, gold trim, a gold cross set in each grip. +20% attack speed; 【Basic】: makes a normal attack on the trigger target (dual-pistol pursuit applies); that normal attack deals at most the trigger value in damage.
equipment.butterfly.name: Butterfly
equipment.calibration_rifle.desc: First rewrites the trigger value into 3.5% of the target's max health, then deals that much magic damage.
equipment.calibration_rifle.name: Calibrated Rifle
equipment.capacitor_codex.desc: A heavy codex with a battery set into its cover, violet sparks along the page edges. The more it stores, the harder it hits. +1 max 【Charged】 on passives, +15 ability power; 3 s cooldown: deals trigger value × (20% + 3% × the charges left on all the holder's 【Charged】 effects) as magic damage to the trigger target; if the target is an ally, heals it for trigger value × (140% + 10% × those charges) instead.
equipment.capacitor_codex.name: Capacitor Codex
equipment.chaos_dice.desc: Node Arcanist's dice staff (anyone can use it): a black staff bound in gold, a big white die held in the golden ring at its head. +20% damage, +1 range; 4 s cooldown 【Multi 3】: deals 0.05 × 1d20 × 3 × trigger value to each target at random — physical on 1–5, magic on 6–15, true on 16–20. If the fallen allies are at least as many as the living ones, it always rolls 20.
equipment.chaos_dice.name: Randomness
equipment.chord_fork.desc: A pair of violet-bronze tuning forks. Strike one and the whole squad's heartbeats fall into step. +100 health; two parts, 【Multi Attack 4】【Dual-mode】: ① 【Basic】: allies gain 1 stack of 【Resonance】 (5 s, stacks to 4: +3% attack speed), enemies take trigger value × 30% magic damage; ② 3 s cooldown: allies gain a shield of trigger value × 35%, enemies take as much magic damage.
equipment.chord_fork.name: Chord Fork
equipment.clotted_blood.desc: Node Vampire's crystallised blood blade (anyone can use it): glowing blood veins cross its dark, black-edged blade. +25% damage over time, +20 armor penetration; 7 s cooldown 【Multi-Attack 8】【Stacking 6】【Chant 3】: when the chant ends, hits every trigger target once per second chanted for trigger value × 12% magic damage (skill damage); each hit adds a stack of 【Fracture】.
equipment.clotted_blood.name: Clotted Blood
equipment.coin_dagger.desc: Node Rogue's dagger and lucky coin (anyone can use them): a straight dagger with a gold guard, and a gold coin always flipping in the off hand. +15% attack speed; 【Basic】【Learning】【Eternal】: if the holder has no 【Coin Purse】 yet, gives one; otherwise adds the trigger value to its coins. The learning count carries over between battles. 【Coin Purse】: doesn't stack, can't be dispelled, lasts forever, and counts coins. Every 2 s it may double or empty: doubling starts at 5% and emptying at 25%; the more it has learned, the likelier doubling and the rarer emptying, but they level off — doubling only approaches 25% and emptying 5% (at 10 learned, both are 15%); when the battle ends it is emptied and you gain that much gold.
equipment.coin_dagger.name: Dagger & Coin
equipment.colorless_bow.desc: Deals a fixed 30 true damage, ignoring the trigger value.
equipment.colorless_bow.name: Colorless Bow
equipment.crimson_fang.desc: A pair of fang-shaped blades, dark red seeping at the roots. They hurt most when they find the vitals. +15% crit chance, +30% crit damage; 1.5 s cooldown 【Crit】: deals trigger value × 70% physical damage to the trigger target; it can crit.
equipment.crimson_fang.name: Crimson Fangs
equipment.cyan_shadow.desc: Node Knight-errant's teal longsword (anyone can use it): the blade glows teal, a cyan gem sits in the gold cross-guard, and a teal tassel hangs from the pommel. +20 attack, +30 ability power; 8 s cooldown 【Charged 1】【Stacking 3】, starts the battle with 1 charge: gains 1 stack of 【Shadow Slay】.
equipment.cyan_shadow.name: Cyan Shadow
equipment.dance_fans.desc: Node Dancer's pair of dancing fans (anyone can use them). +2 attack range, +10% attack speed; from afar she flings arcing rings of magic. 【Basic】【Dual Mode】【Multi Attack 10】: heals teammates for 1.5× trigger value, deals 1.5× trigger value true damage to enemies.
equipment.dance_fans.name: Dancing Fans
equipment.desperation_greatsword.desc: Deals 2× trigger value as physical damage; the lower the wielder's health, the harder it hits.
equipment.desperation_greatsword.name: Desperation Greatsword
equipment.drive_cannon.desc: Node Tinker's rifle (anyone can use it): wooden stock, brass fittings, a purple glow running down the barrel. +20% physical damage, +20% magic damage. 2.5 s cooldown: the trigger target gains 【Emergency Maintenance】 for 3 s — dispellable, doesn't stack; 25% physical lifesteal and 25% spell lifesteal; the moment it's gained, it heals trigger value × 50%.
equipment.drive_cannon.name: Drive Cannon
equipment.dual_use_stunner.desc: Node Shielder's stun gun (anyone can use it). Attack range drops to zero — it only hits enemies in contact; shields received +20%.
equipment.dual_use_stunner.name: Dual-Use Stunner
equipment.easy_shortbow.desc: Node Hunter's recurve shortbow (anyone can use it). +150 max health, +20 attack. 1 s cooldown 【Charged 3】: the trigger holder instantly shoots the trigger target with a normal attack that skips wind-up and recovery; for every 100 trigger value, that shot deals 100% of the normal damage.
equipment.easy_shortbow.name: Handy Shortbow
equipment.echo_blade.desc: A matte-black blade with a row of cyan capacitor cells along the spine. Part of every swing comes back to you. +15 attack, +1 max 【Charged】 on passives, +15% speed for "every few seconds" timers and charge recovery; 4 s cooldown 【Dual-mode】: an ally heals for trigger value × 50%; an enemy takes trigger value × 80% physical damage; either way, the holder's least-charged 【Charged】 effect regains 1 charge.
equipment.echo_blade.name: Echo Blade
equipment.emag_intro.desc: Node Psychic's spellbook (anyone can use it): a navy cover with gold corners and a gold lightning bolt, a sapphire and a gold star hanging from the spine. +40 attack, +30% normal attack damage; 3 s cooldown 【Charged 2】【Learning】【Multi 3】: applies 【Paralysis】 for 8 s. 【Paralysis】: doesn't stack, dispellable, a debuff. The holder takes (1 + learning count)% more damage per 30 trigger value, and has the same chance to be interrupted when a normal attack's wind-up completes; reapplying keeps the higher value.
equipment.emag_intro.name: Introduction to Electromagnetism
equipment.energy_halberd.desc: Dual-mode: 2× trigger value shield on allies, 2× trigger value magic damage on enemies.
equipment.energy_halberd.name: Energy Halberd
equipment.erudite_case.desc: A violet-wood case full of annotated copies. Every volume finished makes the next one faster and surer. +20 ability power; 2 s cooldown 【Learning】: deals trigger value × 15% magic damage to the trigger target, +10% per learning (up to 15 times).
equipment.erudite_case.name: Erudite Case
equipment.farthest_string.desc: Node Leader's bow (anyone can use it): dark limbs wound with golden scrollwork, a cyan gem in the grip, a string that glows pale cyan. Fully drawn normal attacks pick two extra targets. 99 s cooldown 【Charged 9】【Fixed】: starts the battle fully charged. Refreshes the trigger target's once-per-battle skills so they can trigger again.
equipment.farthest_string.name: Farthest String
equipment.fireball_tome.desc: 3× trigger value magic damage, splash 1; each use learns +1 for +12% damage.
equipment.fireball_tome.name: Fireball Grimoire
equipment.flame_banner.desc: Node Gladiator's burning war banner (anyone can use it). +20% crit chance, +40% crit damage. 5 s cooldown 【Crit】【Splash 6】: grants the trigger target +1% attack and attack speed per point of trigger value (permanent; repeated grants add up); the splashed part is only a quarter as strong and only reaches the trigger target's teammates, never enemies.
equipment.flame_banner.name: Crimson Flame Banner
equipment.fleeting_revolver.desc: Node Cowboy's revolver (anyone can use it). Attack range is cut way down (in his hands it's just under 1 m); +25% crit damage. 【Basic】: grants the trigger target 【Big-Caliber Rounds】. 【Big-Caliber Rounds】: doesn't stack, can't be dispelled, lasts forever. The next 6 normal attacks always crit and their base damage (before any bonus or reduction) gains 1× the trigger value; once they're used up, normal attacks can never crit and deal 30% less damage. Gaining it again resets the guaranteed crits.
equipment.fleeting_revolver.name: Fleeting
equipment.forgotten_star_flag.desc: The flag Node Astronaut carries (anyone can use it): white with a blue border and a golden crest — no one recognizes which star it belongs to. +30% shields received, +60 ability power. 【Basic】【Multi Attack 99】【Amplify 2】【Fixed】: the trigger target loses 2% × Amplify of its current health, or 1% × Amplify per 100 trigger value, whichever is higher (health loss ignores shields and damage modifiers).
equipment.forgotten_star_flag.name: Flag of a Forgotten Star
equipment.fortune_cards.desc: A fan of cards in each hand: a good card for a friend, a bad one for a foe. The dealer never looks. +15% crit chance; 2 s cooldown 【Dual-mode】: an ally gains 【Good Luck】 (10 s: +30% crit chance, +30% attack speed); an enemy gains 【Bad Luck】 (10 s: +20% damage taken).
equipment.fortune_cards.name: Fortune Cards
equipment.frenzy_daggers.desc: Deals a fixed 25 physical damage (can crit) and stacks attack speed on the wielder.
equipment.frenzy_daggers.name: Frenzy Daggers
equipment.g10_chrono_sword.desc: Its guard is a ticking little clock face, its blade as long and thin as a minute hand. Whoever holds it feels time run a few notches faster for them. +120 health, +8% haste; 3 s cooldown 【Dual-mode】【Multi Attack 3】: the holder first gains 1 stack of 【Overclock】 (6 s, stacks to 3: +8% haste per stack); then an ally (the holder included) gains a shield of trigger value × 80%, an enemy takes trigger value × 80% magic damage.
equipment.g10_chrono_sword.name: Chronoblade
equipment.g10_current_daggers.desc: Two water-cyan curved blades whose ripple pattern never stops flowing. Those who go with it move faster; those against it can barely move at all. +15% attack speed, +8% normal-attack dodge; 【Fixed】【Dual-mode】: an ally (the holder included) gains a 120 shield and 【With the Current】 (8 s: +25% attack speed and move speed); an enemy takes 120 physical damage and gains 【Against the Current】 (8 s: -25% attack speed and move speed).
equipment.g10_current_daggers.name: Current Daggers
equipment.g10_feast_sword.desc: A deep-crimson longsword whose guard is cast as a golden goblet. It treats every victory as a feast, and the more it drinks the livelier it gets. +30 attack, +150 health, +8% physical lifesteal; 【Basic】: the trigger target heals for trigger value × 100% and gains 1 stack of 【Bloodfeast】 (lasts the battle, stacks to 5: +6% attack and +4% physical lifesteal per stack).
equipment.g10_feast_sword.name: Feastblood Sword
equipment.g10_nightingale_bow.desc: A rosewood longbow whose tips spread into a nightingale's wings, a little silver nightingale perched above the grip. Every twang of the string is a nocturne. +15 attack, +15 ability power, +120 health; both parts 2 s cooldown 【Dual-mode】【Multi Attack 2】: ① an ally (the holder included) heals for trigger value × 60%, an enemy takes trigger value × 60% magic damage; ② an ally (the holder included) gains 【Nocturne】 (6 s: +15% attack speed, +15% healing received), an enemy gains 【Lament】 (6 s: -15% attack speed).
equipment.g10_nightingale_bow.name: Nightingale Longbow
equipment.g10_vine_sword.desc: A sword whittled from a still-living hardwood bough, its blade wound with green vine. Every cut, the vine puts out another leaf. +15 attack, +150 health; ①【Basic】【Fixed】【Dual-mode】: an enemy takes 20 physical damage; whoever the target, the holder gains 1 stack of 【Sprout】 (lasts the battle, stacks to 10: +2% attack and +15 max health per stack); ② 3 s cooldown 【Dual-mode】: an ally (the holder included) heals for trigger value × 100%.
equipment.g10_vine_sword.name: Greenvine Sword
equipment.g10_viper_daggers.desc: A pair of short blades curved like a snake's fangs, green venom forever seeping from the grooves at their roots. Once the snake bites, it doesn't let go. +35 attack, +250 health; 【Fixed】【Dual-mode】: the holder first gains 1 stack of 【Coil】 (lasts the battle, stacks to 4: +8% attack and attack speed per stack); then an enemy gains 3 stacks of 【Viper Venom】 (10 s, stacks to 6, refreshed on each new stack: 30 magic damage per second per stack), an ally (the holder included) heals for 200.
equipment.g10_viper_daggers.name: Viperfang Daggers
equipment.g10_willow_vase.desc: A small celadon vase holding a single sprig of weeping willow. Sprinkled over a friend it is sweet dew; over a foe, the leaves wither one by one. +20 ability power, +15% healing; ①【Basic】【Fixed】【Dual-mode】: an ally (the holder included) gains 【Sweet Dew】 (8 s: +25% healing received, regenerates 25 health per second); an enemy gains 【Wither】 (8 s: -12% attack, -40% healing received); ② 3 s cooldown 【Dual-mode】: an ally heals for trigger value × 120%, an enemy takes trigger value × 120% magic damage.
equipment.g10_willow_vase.name: Willow Vase
equipment.g5_flare_launcher.desc: A rescue team's flare crossbow; what it fires is a signal flare. Beside the wounded it is a call for help; on an enemy it is a ball of fire, and a light everyone can aim at. +20 attack, +150 health; two parts: ① 【Basic】【Dual-mode】: an enemy gains 1 【Burning】 (4 s, 25 magic damage a second) and is 【Lit Up】 (5 s: +15% damage taken); an ally heals 50 health; ② 3 s cooldown 【Dual-mode】: an ally heals trigger value × 80%; an enemy takes trigger value × 80% magic damage.
equipment.g5_flare_launcher.name: Rescue Flare Crossbow
equipment.g5_gale_crossbow.desc: A birch-wood stock with two great feathers for limbs. Whoever holds it keeps getting faster, as if a wind were always at their back. +8% crit chance; 【Basic】: whoever the trigger target is, the holder gains 1 stack of 【Gale】 (lasts the battle, up to 6 stacks: each +4% attack speed, +4% haste, -4% reload time) and a 45-point shield.
equipment.g5_gale_crossbow.name: Galewing Crossbow
equipment.g5_hive_crossbow.desc: A beekeeper's hand crossbow with a whole hive strapped on top. It shoots bees: a mouthful of honey for a friend, a sting for a foe. +200 health, +15% healing; two parts: ① 【Basic】【Dual-mode】: an ally gains 1 stack of 【Honey】 (8 s, stacks to 3: each +8% attack, +8% attack speed); an enemy gains 1 stack of 【Bee Venom】 (8 s, stacks to 3: each 20 magic damage a second); ② 3 s cooldown 【Dual-mode】: an ally heals trigger value × 80%; an enemy takes trigger value × 80% physical damage.
equipment.g5_hive_crossbow.name: Hive Crossbow
equipment.g5_rime_crossbow.desc: A hand crossbow of violet lacquer and icicles, made by the craftsmen of the sky isles. The ice never melts; every shard it looses carries the cold of the peak. +120 health, +15% attack speed; two parts: ① 【Basic】【Dual-mode】: an enemy gains 3 【Chill】 (each -10% attack speed; over 40% in total freezes); an ally gains a 50-point shield; ② 4 s cooldown 【Dual-mode】: an ally gains a shield of trigger value × 90%; an enemy takes trigger value × 90% magic damage.
equipment.g5_rime_crossbow.name: Rimeshard Crossbow
equipment.g5_thorn_crossbow.desc: An old vine-wrapped branch bent into a crossbow. The thorn seeds it shoots grow into bark on a friend, and into brambles at an enemy's feet. +250 health, +20 armor, -20% reload time; two parts, both 【Basic】【Dual-mode】: ① an ally gains a 60-point shield; an enemy takes 60 physical damage; ② an ally gains 1 【Regeneration】 (6 s, 10 health a second); an enemy is 【Thornbound】 (1.5 s: can't move or make normal attacks).
equipment.g5_thorn_crossbow.name: Thornseed Crossbow
equipment.g5_thunder_crossbow.desc: Engineering's electromagnetic crossbow: copper coils push the bolt out while the electrode prongs crackle at the muzzle. Whatever it hits goes numb for a while. +15 attack, +10% attack speed; two parts: ① 【Basic】: deals 40 magic damage to the trigger target and applies 【Paralysis】 (5 s: +20% damage taken, 20% chance for each normal attack to be cut off as it fires); ② 2 s cooldown: deals trigger value × 40% magic damage, and the arc jumps to other enemies within 1.5 m of it (half each).
equipment.g5_thunder_crossbow.name: Thunderclap Crossbow
equipment.g8_crane_pistols.desc: Two stacks of cranes folded from cyan letter paper, one in each hand. A released crane always finds its addressee: for a friend, a letter held up in front of them; for a foe, a paper edge sharp enough to cut. +150 health, +15 magic resistance; 【Basic】【Multi Attack 3】【Dual-mode】: each activation first gives the holder a 30-point shield; then ① an ally gains a 30-point shield; an enemy takes 30 magic damage; ② an enemy gains 1 stack of 【Paper Cut】 (5 s, stacks to 5: +4% damage taken per stack).
equipment.g8_crane_pistols.name: Paper Crane Pistols
equipment.g8_dart_pistols.desc: Field-issue tranquilizer pistols from Welfare, a row of violet vials plugged into each frame. The same dart is a stimulant in a teammate and a neurotoxin in a foe. +150 health, +12% attack speed; two parts: ① 【Basic】【Dual-mode】: an enemy gains 1 stack of 【Neurotoxin】 (6 s, stacks to 3: -10% attack speed and +6% damage taken per stack); an ally gains 【Stimulant】 (5 s: +20% attack speed, +20% healing received); ② 3 s cooldown 【Dual-mode】: an ally heals trigger value × 80%; an enemy takes trigger value × 80% magic damage.
equipment.g8_dart_pistols.name: Dosing Dart Pistols
equipment.g8_firework_tubes.desc: Two red-ribboned hand-held firework tubes. Every shot bursts into a flower in mid-air: beside a friend it's a celebration, over a foe it's a deafening bang. +30 attack, +200 health; three parts: ① 【Basic】【Splash】【Dual-mode】: an ally heals 40 health; an enemy takes 40 magic damage; its allies within 1.5 m get half; ② 【Basic】【Splash】【Dual-mode】: an ally gains 【Festival】 (5 s: +12% attack, +12% attack speed); an enemy gains 【Ringing Ears】 (5 s: -15% attack speed); its allies within 1.5 m get the same; ③ 3 s cooldown 【Dual-mode】: an ally heals trigger value × 50%; an enemy takes trigger value × 50% magic damage.
equipment.g8_firework_tubes.name: Festival Firework Tubes
equipment.g8_peapod_pistols.desc: Two big dried pea pods with their mouths whittled into barrels. A pea that lands on a friend cracks into a hard shell; one that hits a foe in the face leaves it seeing stars. +150 health, -15% reload time; two parts, both 【Basic】【Dual-mode】: ① an ally gains a 45-point shield; an enemy takes 45 physical damage; ② an ally gains 【Pod Shell】 (6 s: -20% damage taken); an enemy is 【Stunned】 for 1 s (halved on elites and bosses).
equipment.g8_peapod_pistols.name: Peapod Shooters
equipment.g8_rivet_guns.desc: Maintenance's pneumatic rivet guns, one in each hand. Other departments fix trucks with them; Maintenance patches their teammates' armor — the rivets go in while they're still red-hot. +15 armor, +120 health, +10% attack speed; 【Basic】【Splash】: the trigger target gains a 35-point shield, and each of its allies within 2.4 m gains 35 too; the holder gains 1 stack of 【Riveted】 (lasts the battle, stacks to 5: +5 armor and +5 magic resistance per stack).
equipment.g8_rivet_guns.name: Rivet Guns
equipment.g8_sunray_blasters.desc: Research's replica of the ray guns in old pulp sci-fi: gold bodies, and a little sun caged in each glass reflector. Pull the trigger and a beam of daylight leaves everyone squinting. +30 attack, +20 ability power; 2 s cooldown 【Multi Attack 3】: the trigger targets take trigger value × 110% magic damage and are 【Dazzled】 (3 s: -25% attack speed, -25% move speed).
equipment.g8_sunray_blasters.name: Sunray Blasters
equipment.g9_dawnlight_spear.desc: An ivory lance crowned with a golden rising sun. Raise it at the darkest moment and the day breaks. +200 health, +15 armor; 2 s cooldown: the trigger target gains a shield of trigger value × 150% and 【Dawnlight】 (12 s: +15% damage reduction, +20% attack).
equipment.g9_dawnlight_spear.name: Dawnlight Spear
equipment.g9_laurel_greatsword.desc: A crimson greatsword with a golden laurel crown for a guard and a laurel branch engraved to its tip. Every victory, it sings another line of the triumph. +35 attack, +200 health; 【Basic】: the trigger target gains 1 stack of 【Paean】 per 20 trigger value (lasts the battle, stacks to 10: +4% attack and +2% physical lifesteal per stack), and heals trigger value × 100%.
equipment.g9_laurel_greatsword.name: Laurel Greatsword
equipment.g9_rimetide_spear.desc: A spear that froze a breaking wave mid-crash; the wave still curls beside its icy blade. Whoever it sweeps moves slower each time, until they freeze solid. +150 health, +10% attack speed; 【Basic】【Multi Attack 4】【Fixed】: deals 50 magic damage to the trigger targets and applies 3 【Chill】 to each.
equipment.g9_rimetide_spear.name: Rimetide Spear
equipment.g9_starorbit_lance.desc: A night-sky lance whose blade rests in a crescent moon, circled by two orbits of stars. Starlight shines on friends; star-shadow weighs on foes. +250 health; two parts, 2 s cooldown 【Dual-mode】【Multi Attack 4】: ① allies gain 【Star Ward】 (6 s: +20 armor and magic resist), enemies gain 【Eclipse】 (6 s: -12% attack); ② allies heal trigger value × 50%, enemies take trigger value × 60% magic damage.
equipment.g9_starorbit_lance.name: Starorbit Lance
equipment.g9_thornbrand.desc: A wooden greatsword overgrown with thorns. Every cut leaves a thorn behind — and whoever hits that foe next drives it in deeper. +20 attack, +120 health; 【Basic】【Fixed】: deals 20 physical damage to the trigger target and applies 1 stack of 【Thorns】 (5 s, stacks to 6: each normal-attack hit it takes deals +6 damage per stack).
equipment.g9_thornbrand.name: Thornbrand
equipment.g9_wellspring_greatsword.desc: An aquamarine crystal greatsword with a clear spring running through its blade. Every splash it cuts away falls back on whoever needs it most. +50 ability power, +250 health; 3 s cooldown 【Multi Attack 4】: deals trigger value × 70% magic damage to the trigger targets; each hit heals the ally with the least health (not at full) by as much as it dealt.
equipment.g9_wellspring_greatsword.name: Wellspring Greatsword
equipment.gilded_saber.desc: A cavalry saber gilded from tip to pommel, its guard a rising sun. The faster it cuts, the sooner the next cut comes. +30 attack, +150 health; 【Basic】【Fixed】: deals 30 physical damage to the trigger target, and the holder gains 1 stack of 【Momentum】 (4 s, stacks to 6: +3% attack speed per stack).
equipment.gilded_saber.name: Gilded Saber
equipment.goldcrow_longbow.desc: A golden longbow with a blazing sun disc set into the grip and black crow feathers at both tips; its arrows carry the daylight. Every arrow raises the sun a little higher. +30 attack, +20 ability power, +10% crit chance, +30% crit damage; 2 s cooldown 【Dual-mode】【Learning】【Crit】: an ally heals trigger value × 100%; an enemy takes trigger value × 120% physical damage (either can crit); +8% for every time it has learned this battle (up to 15).
equipment.goldcrow_longbow.name: Goldcrow Longbow
equipment.harvest_rake.desc: Node Peasant's rake (anyone can use it). 20 s cooldown: opens a 1.2 m 【Paddy Field】 under the trigger target for 8 s. 【Paddy Field】: can't be targeted or destroyed, belongs to no side; every heal received by anyone standing on it gains a flat 10% of the trigger value.
equipment.harvest_rake.name: Bountiful Harvest
equipment.healing_orb.desc: Heals 1× trigger value; 5% great success (×2), 5% fail (nothing).
equipment.healing_orb.name: Healing Crystal Ball
equipment.heart_syringe.desc: Node Nurse's big syringe (anyone can use it). +15 attack, +15% attack speed; normal attacks shoot syringe darts. 1.5 s cooldown 【Splash 1.5】【Crit】: deals 1× trigger value physical damage to the trigger target; it counts as normal-attack damage (normal-attack damage reduction applies to it; on allies, Node Nurse's 【Care in the Broad Sense】 turns it into healing, while the part that splashes onto enemies still deals damage).
equipment.heart_syringe.name: Heart Syringe
equipment.hexline_rifle.desc: An ebony rifle carved all over with violet hex-lines, an amethyst set into the receiver. When the lines light up, the bullet picks a side for its owner. +20 ability power, +120 health, +12% attack speed; two parts, 【Basic】【Dual-mode】【Fixed】: ① an ally gains 【Hexline】 (6 s: normal attacks' physical damage carries 25% extra as magic damage, +15 ability power); an enemy takes 80 magic damage; ② an ally also gains a 70-point shield.
equipment.hexline_rifle.name: Hexline Rifle
equipment.hope.desc: Node Brave's knightly sword (anyone can use it): a gold cross inlaid on the silver blade, a large sapphire set in the gold guard. +30 ability power, +300 max health; 9 s cooldown 【Multi-Attack 2】: heals each trigger target for 1 × trigger value. If it has fallen, it is revived with that much health.
equipment.hope.name: Hope
equipment.hunt_flag.desc: A special item Node Gladiator puts in the armory while she is on the field; it can't be worn. Drag it onto an enemy: when the battle starts Node Gladiator treats it as her quarry. It returns to the armory after use (drag again to pick someone else); several Node Gladiators share one flag.
equipment.hunt_flag.name: Hunting Flag
equipment.ice_lance_tome.desc: 0.5× trigger value magic damage, splash 1; each use learns +1 for +8% damage.
equipment.ice_lance_tome.name: Ice Lance Grimoire
equipment.kaleidoscope.desc: A brass tube with turning crystal shards at the far end. Whoever is seen through it feels the light coming from every side. +20 ability power; 3 s cooldown 【Multi Attack 3】, two parts: ① 60 magic damage to each trigger target, plus 1 stack of 【Shattered Light】 (6 s, stacks to 2: -15 magic resist); ② trigger value × 10% magic damage to each.
equipment.kaleidoscope.name: Kaleidoscope
equipment.keeneye_rifle.desc: A long deep-violet rifle whose brass scope lens is an open eye. Whoever holds it always sees the weakest point. +15% crit chance, +25% crit damage; crit chance above 100% turns into crit damage 1:1; 3 s cooldown 【Dual-mode】: an ally gains 【Keen Eye】 (5 s: +30% crit chance, +30% crit damage); an enemy takes trigger value × 80% physical damage 【Crit】.
equipment.keeneye_rifle.name: Keen-Eye Rifle
equipment.kill_blade.desc: Node Killer's ōdachi (anyone can use it): a long blade kept in a black lacquered scabbard, dark-green hilt wrap and a gold guard. +50 attack, +15% attack speed; 【Basic】【Awakening: only one enemy left】【Eternal】【Learning】【Fixed】【Multi 9】: if the target is a summon, removes it; otherwise removes 6% of its max health. The learning count carries over between battles; when it reaches 40, the holder permanently loses a star — at 1 star, the holder is removed and the weapon returns to the armory.
equipment.kill_blade.name: Kill
equipment.light_heart.desc: The yellow crystal orb Node Absolver holds (anyone can use it): a light that never goes out burns at its heart. +15 attack, +40 ability power; 【Basic】【Multi-Attack 6】: if a trigger target's current health is below 12 × trigger value, it is executed (its on-death effects don't trigger).
equipment.light_heart.name: Heart of Light
equipment.lightning_gloves.desc: Node Runner's gloves (anyone can use them): fingerless, with knuckle plates and a glowing violet energy ring on the back of each hand. +20% move speed. 2 s cooldown: deals trigger value × 80% magic damage and knocks the target away from the user by trigger value × 0.004 m (up to 3 m).
equipment.lightning_gloves.name: Lightning Gloves
equipment.meteor_staff.desc: Node Witch's long staff (anyone can use it). +120 ability power, +40 flat magic penetration. 8 s cooldown 【Charged 2】【Multi Attack 12】【Splash 3】 (every multi-attack target splashes): calls a meteor down on each trigger target that explodes on landing for 1.85× trigger value magic damage. Charges start at 0 (the first one is ready 8 s into the battle).
equipment.meteor_staff.name: Meteor Blast Staff
equipment.mistveil_daggers.desc: Two mist-cyan blades whose faces are always damp. Every time they strike, their wielder steps half a pace further into the fog. +25 attack, +10% attack speed, +15% normal-attack dodge; 2 s cooldown 【Dual-mode】: the holder gains 【Mistveil】 (12 s: +20% normal-attack dodge, +20% attack speed, +20% attack); then an ally (the holder included) gains a shield of trigger value × 150%, an enemy takes trigger value × 150% physical damage.
equipment.mistveil_daggers.name: Mistveil Daggers
equipment.momentum_repeater.desc: A lever-action repeater with a gold receiver and a long tube magazine under the barrel. Every pull of the lever feels smoother than the last. +10% attack speed, +30% crit damage; two parts: ① 【Basic】【Fixed】: deals 50 physical damage to the trigger target, and the holder gains 1 stack of 【Momentum】 (8 s, stacks to 5: +5% attack per stack); ② 【Basic】【Crit】: deals trigger value × 100% physical damage as well (it can crit).
equipment.momentum_repeater.name: Momentum Repeater
equipment.myriad_words.desc: Node Spy's bamboo slips (anyone can use them): two white bundles covered in writing no one can read. +2 【Charged】 on the wielder's passives. Effect: gain trigger value experience and gold.
equipment.myriad_words.name: Myriad Words
equipment.necro_grimoire.desc: Node Medium's grimoire (anyone can use it): black covers, gold corners and a violet gem; skull wisps drift out when it opens. The wielder counts as +1 star for whatever she summons. 5 s cooldown 【Charged 2】【Summon】: summons a ghost behind the trigger target whose first attack deals extra damage equal to trigger value × 0.03.
equipment.necro_grimoire.name: Grimoire
equipment.old_censer.desc: Node Perfume's bronze censer (anyone can use it): teal smoke curls from its pierced lid. +15% healing; 8 s cooldown 【Multi-Attack 6】【Stacking 6】: every 150 points of trigger value gives the target 1 stack of 【Infusion】 for 8 s.
equipment.old_censer.name: Old Censer
equipment.open_shut_key.desc: Node Cultist's giant key (anyone can use it): a long dark-green shaft with a golden, ruby-set bow. +350 max health, +15% attack speed; 6 s cooldown 【Multi 5】: yanks the targets hard toward a single point, bunching them up, then 【Stuns】 them for 1 s per 200 trigger value.
equipment.open_shut_key.name: Open and Shut
equipment.order_sword.desc: Dual-mode: 1.5× trigger value shield on allies, 1× trigger value magic damage on enemies.
equipment.order_sword.name: Sword of Order
equipment.prism_scythe.desc: Node Magi's scythe (anyone can use it): a long shaft and a glowing violet crescent blade. It looks like a polearm but counts as a two-handed heavy weapon. +30 attack, +30 ability power. 2.5 s cooldown 【Multi Attack 3】: deals trigger value × 1 physical damage.
equipment.prism_scythe.name: Prism Scythe
equipment.puppet_lantern.desc: A puppeteer's lantern with silver threads hanging beneath it. Whatever it shines on moves — faster than before. +15 ability power; 4 s cooldown: all of the holder's summons gain 【Puppet Strings】 (5 s): +25% attack and attack speed, and heal for trigger value × 30%.
equipment.puppet_lantern.name: Puppeteer's Lantern
equipment.rainbow_flower.desc: Node Wizard's wand, a rainbow flower blooming at its tip (anyone can use it). +100 ability power; the wearer's passive skills get +1 【Amplify】. 【Basic】【Fixed】【Pursuit 2】: deals one of these at random (each hit rolls again): 5 physical damage (counts as normal-attack damage), 5 magic damage (skill damage), or 5 true damage over time (lands 1 s later).
equipment.rainbow_flower.name: Prism Bloom
equipment.rally_blade.desc: An officer's short sword with a cyan streamer on the hilt. Raise it, and the people around you charge. +15 attack, +120 health; 2 s cooldown 【Multi 3】【Fixed】: the trigger target gains a stack of 【Rallied】 (8 s, up to 4): +6% attack and +6% attack speed per stack.
equipment.rally_blade.name: Rallying Blade
equipment.rapidfire_arbalest.desc: Node Archer's repeating crossbow (anyone can use it). Deals a fixed 25 physical damage, then 【Pursuit 1】 fires once more.
equipment.rapidfire_arbalest.name: Repeating Arbalest
equipment.requiem_banner.desc: A pale hand-held requiem banner with a bronze bell at its tip. Whoever it names does not go quietly. +150 health, +20 ability power; 2 s cooldown 【Fixed】: all of the holder's summons gain 【Requiem Soul】: +30% max health; when one falls, it deals its max health × 50% as magic damage to enemies within 2 m.
equipment.requiem_banner.name: Requiem Banner
equipment.resonance_bells.desc: A pair of rune-etched bronze hand bells. One ring, and the sound hardens into a shell on friends and rattles the bones of foes. +20 armor, +20 magic resist; 2 s cooldown 【Dual-mode】【Multi Attack 3】: allies gain a shield of trigger value × 150%; enemies take trigger value × 150% magic damage.
equipment.resonance_bells.name: Resonance Bells
equipment.returning_tide.desc: A pearl-white rifle with a wave-crest stock and a glass tube of seawater along the barrel; it fires drops of water. The tide goes out — and always comes back in. +12% attack speed, +200 health; two parts, 【Dual-mode】【Fixed】: ① 4 s cooldown: an ally heals 180; an enemy takes 180 magic damage; ② 【Limited: when someone falls】 once per battle: if the trigger target is a fallen ally (or the holder), it gets back up where it fell, with 400 health.
equipment.returning_tide.name: Returning Tide
equipment.ribbon_daggers.desc: A pair of dancing knives trailing long golden ribbons. Spun past a friend, the ribbon is a cheer; past a foe, it's a cut. +15 attack, +8% physical lifesteal; 【Basic】【Multi Attack 4】【Dual-mode】: allies gain 1 stack of 【Cheer】 (5 s, stacks to 5: +3% attack and +2% physical lifesteal per stack); enemies take trigger value × 50% physical damage.
equipment.ribbon_daggers.name: Ribbon Daggers
equipment.rockbreaker.desc: A greatsword that looks hewn straight out of a cliff, cold blue light seeping through its cracks. It breaks armor as well as bones. +30 attack, +30 ability power, +15 armor; 4 s cooldown 【Multi 4】: deals trigger value × 150% physical damage to the trigger targets and adds a stack of 【Cracked Armor】 (8 s, up to 3): -20 armor and magic resist per stack.
equipment.rockbreaker.name: Rockbreaker
equipment.root_greatsword.desc: Deals a fixed 50 physical damage and heals the wielder for 30.
equipment.root_greatsword.name: Rootwood Greatsword
equipment.sample_arcane_edge.desc: Deals 4× the trigger value as magic damage.
equipment.sample_arcane_edge.name: Arcane Edge
equipment.sample_splash_potion.desc: Splash 2: heals 50% of the trigger value on whoever the trigger targets, friend or foe.
equipment.sample_splash_potion.name: Splash Flask
equipment.silent_lute.desc: Node Bard's lute (anyone can use it): a dark body studded with blue and violet gems. +20 ability power; 6 s cooldown 【Dual Mode】【Fixed】: grants an ally 6% damage amplification, or gives an enemy -6% damage reduction, for 6 s; doubled if the wielder is chanting (drawing a bowstring counts).
equipment.silent_lute.name: Silent Lute
equipment.sinking_dream.desc: Node Pacifist's microphone (anyone can use it): a dark-brown grip, a gold band set with a sapphire, a gold cross and white tassel hanging from the end. +20% attack speed; 4 s cooldown 【Multi-Attack 10】【Dual Mode】: depending on the trigger target's side, raises a teammate's damage amplification efficacy (1% per 1.5 trigger value) or an enemy's damage reduction efficacy (1% per 1.5 trigger value), for 5.5 s.
equipment.sinking_dream.name: Sinking Dream
equipment.spell_notes.desc: Node Student's grimoire (anyone can use it). 3 s cooldown. 【Learning】. Grants the wielder one 【Garbled Incantation】, then deals 1× trigger value as magic damage to the trigger target. 【Garbled Incantation】: every copy is independent (no stacking, refreshing or merging), lasts 6 s, can be dispelled; it is one of the following at random, scaled by this activation's learning count N: attack speed +3%×N, ability power +3×N, or damage +2%×N.
equipment.spell_notes.name: Spell Notes
equipment.spotter_rifle.desc: A rifle with a brass rangefinder scope and a yellow marking lamp under the muzzle. Shoot once — then everyone shoots there. +15% attack speed; 1.5 s cooldown 【Fixed】: deals 120 physical damage to the trigger target and inflicts 【Exposed】 (4 s): it takes 15% more damage.
equipment.spotter_rifle.name: Spotter's Rifle
equipment.stardust_orb.desc: A glass orb full of stardust; give it a shake and a mote flies out. One mote is nothing. Many are something else. +15 ability power; 【Basic】: deals 16 magic damage to the trigger target and applies 1 stack of 【Star Mark】 (5 s, stacks to 5: +2% damage taken).
equipment.stardust_orb.name: Stardust Orb
equipment.sturdy_cane.desc: Node Druid's walking staff (anyone can use it). +30% healing bonus. 【Basic】【Multi Attack 4】: heals the trigger targets for 1× trigger value; overheal turns into shield (up to 15% of the target's max health).
equipment.sturdy_cane.name: Sturdy Cane
equipment.talisman_edict.desc: The yellow talisman in Node Taoist's hand. +20% healing bonus, +10% damage bonus. 【Basic】【Stacking 3】【Fixed】【Dual Mode】: applies a stack of 【Edict】 to the target, smartly raising or lowering one of its max health / ability power / attack depending on its side and role (a fixed 10% per stack): allied tanks get max health, allies that fight with ability power get ability power, everyone else gets attack; enemies get the same stat lowered. 【Edict】: stacks, dispellable, lasts 7 s; 6 variants, the 3 lowering ones are negative effects.
equipment.talisman_edict.name: Edict Talisman
equipment.thunder_greatsword.desc: A broad brass-edged greatsword with a glowing lightning seam down its core. When it comes down, the thunder arrives before the blade. +10 attack, +15% attack speed, +200 health; 4 s cooldown 【Multi Attack 5】: deals trigger value × 60% physical damage to the trigger targets and 【Stuns】 them for 2 s.
equipment.thunder_greatsword.name: Thunderclap Greatsword
equipment.transfusion_rifle.desc: A white-lacquered rifle with two blood bags hung on the stock, clear tubing running into the receiver. On a friend it's a transfusion; on a foe it's a bloodletting. +30 attack, +150 health; 【Basic】【Dual-mode】【Fixed】: an ally gains 【Transfused】 (5 s: +40% healing received, +10% attack); an enemy is given 【Bloodletting】 (5 s, 25 physical damage per second; each one is separate, several can run at once).
equipment.transfusion_rifle.name: Transfusion Rifle
equipment.true_flower.desc: Node Noble's spear (anyone can use it): flowering vines and petals wind up the shaft, and a lily blooms at its tip. +15% attack speed, +10% damage reduction; 1 s cooldown 【Charged 3】: deals trigger value × 150% magic normal-attack damage to the target, then heals the wielder for trigger value × 60%.
equipment.true_flower.name: True Flower
equipment.twin_candelabra.desc: A two-headed candelabra: one flame burns warm gold, the other cold violet — warm on friends, cold on foes. +10 ability power; 3 s cooldown 【Dual-mode】: an ally heals for trigger value × 40%; an enemy takes trigger value × 40% magic damage.
equipment.twin_candelabra.name: Twin Candelabra
equipment.twin_chakram.desc: Two saw-edged rings that find their own way back. Whoever they graze is always half a step slower. +20 attack; 【Basic】【Multi Attack 3】: each trigger target takes 25 physical damage and is 【Hindered】 (3 s: -20% move speed).
equipment.twin_chakram.name: Twin Chakrams
equipment.twin_flintlock.desc: A pair of brass-capped flintlocks with absurdly long barrels. Not fast, but every shot leaves a choking cloud of smoke. +15% attack speed; two parts: ① 【Basic】: deals 35 physical damage to the trigger target; ② 2 s cooldown: deals trigger value × 50% physical damage and applies 1 stack of 【Gunsmoke】 (5 s, stacks to 3: -6 armor).
equipment.twin_flintlock.name: Twin Flintlocks
equipment.verdant_grove.desc: Node Warden's staff (anyone can use it): a vine-wrapped wooden staff whose ring-shaped head holds a green orb, with a red bead and a white fang hanging below. +300 max health, +30 ability power; 12 s cooldown 【Charged 2】【Learning】, starting with all charges: gains (4 − learning count)% attack speed per 40 trigger value and restores (0 + learning count)% max health per 30 trigger value.
equipment.verdant_grove.name: Verdant Grove
equipment.verdict_sword.desc: A ceremonial longsword with an amethyst hilt and a tiny pair of scales for a guard. It promises shelter to friends and reads out the charges to foes. +150 health, +10 armor; 2 s cooldown 【Fixed】【Dual-mode】【Multi Attack 3】: allies gain 【Sworn Ward】 (8 s: -12% damage taken); enemies gain 【Condemned】 (8 s: +12% damage taken).
equipment.verdict_sword.name: Verdict Sword
equipment.waning_moon.desc: A crescent saber with a full moon set into its spine. Every cut makes the moon a little brighter. +15% attack speed, +5% crit chance; 1 s cooldown, two parts: ① 【Fixed】【Learning】 deals 50 magic damage to the trigger target, +8% for every time it has learned this battle (up to 15); ② plus trigger value × 20% magic damage. The more often it fires, the stronger it gets.
equipment.waning_moon.name: Waning Moon
equipment.ward_mirror.desc: A silver-framed cyan crystal hand mirror. Whoever it reflects gains an unseen wall, as thick as the moment that reflected them. +100 health, +15 magic resist; 4 s cooldown: the trigger target gains a shield equal to trigger value × 70%, and 【Crystal Wall】 (4 s: -12% damage taken).
equipment.ward_mirror.name: Ward Mirror
equipment.warhammer.desc: Node Paladin's war hammer (anyone can use it): a dark wooden haft bound in gold, a grey stone head rimmed in gold with a golden sun-cross on both faces. +30 ability power, +10% damage reduction; 4 s cooldown 【Multi 4】: applies 【Stun】 for 1 s per 100 trigger value.
equipment.warhammer.name: War Hammer
equipment.white_keys.name: White Keys
equipment.wildfire_pistols.desc: 1.2× trigger value magic damage, splash 2; 5% great success (×2), 5% fail.
equipment.wildfire_pistols.name: Wildfire Pistols
equipment.windchaser_bow.desc: A pale-wood recurve shortbow with cyan feathers and ribbons tied to its tips. The wind at your back is the wind in their face. +20 attack, +120 health, +20% attack speed; two parts, 【Dual-mode】: ① 2 s cooldown: an ally gains 【Tailwind】 (5 s: +20% attack speed, +20% move speed); an enemy is given 【Headwind】 (5 s: -20% attack speed, -20% move speed); ② 2 s cooldown: an ally heals trigger value × 150%; an enemy takes trigger value × 150% physical damage.
equipment.windchaser_bow.name: Windchaser Shortbow
equipment.wolf_blades.desc: Node Berserker's wolf-fang twin blades (anyone can use them). 15 s cooldown 【Crit】【Multi Attack 3】: deals 2× trigger value physical damage; if his health is below 10% when it triggers, the damage is tripled.
equipment.wolf_blades.name: Wolf Fangs
equipment.work_helper.desc: Node Basic's wrench (only white pieces can equip it). No stat bonuses. Effect: creates as many white orbs as the trigger value.
equipment.work_helper.name: Little Work Helper
event.ash_storm.body:
The wind has lifted the ashes of the whole city.
Visibility is down to a few meters; the wipers smear two red arcs across the windshield.
There are sparks in the ash, and in the sparks, other things moving.
event.ash_storm.res.dark: Lights, radar, engine — all off. Things pass along the side of the truck in the dark, more than one. They have your scent now.
event.ash_storm.res.drive: The truck pushes through the storm all night. By morning the paint is sanded pale and every window is crazed with cracks.
event.ash_storm.res.wait: You pull up under a wall and wait for it to blow over. It takes a long time.
event.ash_storm.title: Ash Storm
event.blowout.body:
A bang. Everyone looks the same way.
The rear right tire has split wide open; the rim is already sitting on the asphalt.
There's nothing on either side of this road.
event.blowout.res.part: The Nodes strip a part and patch the tire with what's left of it.
event.blowout.res.rim: The rim throws sparks the whole way. By the time there's somewhere to change the tire, the whole rear axle needs replacing.
event.blowout.res.spare: Jack, wrench, spare. By the time the truck is back on the ground, the light has changed.
event.blowout.title: Blowout
event.burning_fountain.body:
Passing the ruins of a park, you witness a strange sight.
At the park's center, the fountain that once sprayed cool water now pours out a pillar of fire three people tall...
The flames imitate the scenery that once delighted humans, falling in graceful arcs.
Within this absurd, unreal scene lies a heat that could devour any human.
What will you do?
event.burning_fountain.opt.collect: Risk it and collect a sample of the flames.
event.burning_fountain.opt.destroy: This thing is evil. Destroy the fountain.
event.burning_fountain.opt.study: Try to understand how it works.
event.burning_fountain.res.collect: You back the truck up to the basin while the Nodes hold up heat shields and push the canisters into the fire. An arc of flame sweeps across the cargo box and scorches the paint black — but the canisters are full of dancing phlogiston.
event.burning_fountain.res.destroy_fight:
The fountain shatters — but the pillar of fire does not go out. It twists and gathers in midair, and red-hot figures step out of the flames one after another.
They do not like being disturbed.
event.burning_fountain.res.destroy_gold: One precise shot severs the feed pipe under the nozzle. The pillar of fire wavers and collapses into embers. The dried-out basin reveals a layer of coins baked to a shine — many people once made wishes here.
event.burning_fountain.res.study: The Nodes spend a long while around the fountain taking notes: the paths of the arcs, the rise and fall of the heat, the rhythm of the nozzle. Nobody can fully explain it, but everyone learns something.
event.burning_fountain.title: The Burning Fountain
event.dig_site.body:
There's a half-dug pit by the road. A shovel is still stuck in the dirt, next to a burned-out excavator.
Someone was digging for something here and left before finishing — or never got the chance to leave.
The corner of a wooden crate shows at the bottom. The truck's winch could reach it.
event.dig_site.res.dig1: The winch drags off the first layer. Underneath is a crate of seeds, still wrapped in oilpaper and not yet sprouting. The cargo box loses a strip of paint.
event.dig_site.res.dig2: The second layer is damp. The crate holds neat rows of mineral-water bottles, and whatever is inside them flows upward.
event.dig_site.res.dig3_empty: Third layer. The crate is light; prised open, it's empty except for a note: "Don't go any deeper."
event.dig_site.res.dig3_gold: Third layer. The crate is so heavy the winch motor smokes — it's full of coins.
event.dig_site.res.dig4_collapse: Fourth layer. The pit wall gives way and half the truck slides in. It takes the Nodes an hour to drag it out.
event.dig_site.res.dig4_orb: The fourth layer is warm. Inside the crate lies a rainbow orb, pulsing like a heart that hasn't stopped.
event.dig_site.res.pack_up: You stick the shovel back in the dirt. The crate at the bottom is covered again.
event.dig_site.title: The Dig Site
event.entropy_well.body:
There's a well by the highway. Ice has formed on its rim, and the rope moves by itself.
The water flows upward, hangs above the mouth as a blue-glowing sphere, then drips back down.
What comes up in the bucket isn't water.
event.entropy_well.opt.drink: Let a Node take a sip.
event.entropy_well.res.cover: As the lid closes, something inside makes a sound like water sighing.
event.entropy_well.res.draw: A bucket of liquid negentropy. It climbs over the rim and etches a patch of white frost into the cargo box's steel.
event.entropy_well.res.drink_boon: The Node takes a sip and shivers. For days afterwards, the air around them goes cold whenever they strike.
event.entropy_well.res.drink_lost: The Node takes a sip, looks into the well, then climbs down the rope. You wait until dawn. The rope never stops moving.
event.entropy_well.title: The Entropy Well
event.gacha_machine.body:
The whole street is dark; only the gacha machine outside the arcade is still lit.
The glass dome is packed with colored capsules, and a handwritten note is wedged under the coin slot: "Gold coins only."
There is no cable behind the machine. Whatever keeps it running, it isn't electricity.
event.gacha_machine.res.ball_blue: The lights go around twice before stopping. A blue capsule drops out — heavier than it looks.
event.gacha_machine.res.ball_gold: Every light comes on at once. A gold capsule drops out, and all the other capsules in the dome shrink back a little.
event.gacha_machine.res.ball_white: The machine whirs through a turn and a white capsule clunks out of the chute.
event.gacha_machine.res.eat: The slot swallows the coin. The machine goes quiet for a few seconds and nothing comes out. The note has grown a new line: "Thank you for playing."
event.gacha_machine.res.shake_ball: The Nodes grab the machine and rock it; a stuck white capsule falls out. Then something inside snaps, and the lights go dead.
event.gacha_machine.res.shake_hit: The machine doesn't budge. Backing the truck into it dents the rear bumper — the lights go out and never come back.
event.gacha_machine.res.walk: You keep your coins. A few steps on, you glance back: the lights seem a little dimmer than before.
event.gacha_machine.title: The Gacha Machine
event.last_tram.body:
As the truck turns onto an avenue with rails set into the asphalt, the road begins to tremble.
A streetcar comes rolling in from the far end of the street. The car is filled with fire; its windows glow one by one, and behind every pane stands a black figure.
It stops right on time at a platform burned down to its frame. The doors open and a hoarse announcement calls the name of the stop — nobody gets off, and nobody gets on.
This city has no passengers left, yet the fire still remembers its timetable.
What will you do?
event.last_tram.opt.board: Board it. There is still luggage on the racks.
event.last_tram.opt.watch: Watch it leave, then read the stop sign.
event.last_tram.res.board_fight:
The moment the Nodes step through the door, every figure in the car turns its head at once.
The hand straps are still swinging. One after another they step off and line up on the platform.
This car has been full for a long time.
event.last_tram.res.follow:
The doors close, the bell rings twice, and the streetcar pulls out. It rams aside the rubble and wrecks lying across the rails, and the truck follows right on its tail lights.
The tongue of fire trailing behind it blisters the paint on the cab — but the road ahead is clear.
event.last_tram.res.watch:
The doors close and the streetcar rolls off down the street trailing a long string of sparks, turns at the next junction, and is gone.
The route map on the stop sign has not burned away yet. Following it, the Nodes mark the nearby streets on the map one by one.
event.last_tram.title: The Last Tram
event.lost_armory.body:
A steel door sits half buried in the embankment beside the highway. Light leaks through the crack.
The electronic lock is still live. A faded notice beside the keypad reads: "Level 5 personnel and above only."
It isn't people the lock is keeping out. It's rank.
event.lost_armory.res.blast: One precise shot wrecks the lock. The blast brings down half the embankment onto the truck — but the weapon on the rack is yours.
event.lost_armory.res.door: There's loose change in the cabinet by the door. You leave the door alone.
event.lost_armory.res.hack: The lock accepts your rank. One unclaimed weapon is still on the rack inside, and a drawer holds a stack of wages nobody collected.
event.lost_armory.title: The Lost Armory
event.old_altar.body:
An altar stands in the middle of the highway — the same kind you saw outside the city on the day you set out.
It doesn't belong to this chapter. It doesn't belong to any chapter.
The hollow on top is exactly the size of the truck's fuel cap.
event.old_altar.res.offer_gold: The coins vanish into the hollow. Your strongest Node suddenly stands straighter — every blow from now on lands harder.
event.old_altar.res.offer_hp: A plate of the truck's armor is pulled onto the altar. In exchange, the light on one Node splits into two.
event.old_altar.res.offer_mats: The three materials blend together in the hollow, and the altar lights up. For the rest of this chapter, fabrication rolls run in your favor.
event.old_altar.res.study: The Nodes study the altar for a long time and copy down the patterns on it.
event.old_altar.title: The Old Altar
event.old_friend.body:
Someone is sitting by the road on a suitcase, a long weapon case at their feet.
It's one of the old convoy. He says he's done with the road, but what he has can go with you.
event.old_friend.res.favor: He writes down a few addresses — people along this road still owe him. At every stop left in this chapter, someone leaves a little extra for the truck.
event.old_friend.res.join_no: He shakes his head, but tells you everything he knows about the road ahead.
event.old_friend.res.join_yes: He's quiet for a long time, then throws the suitcase into the truck.
event.old_friend.res.take_weapon: Whatever is in the case has been well looked after. He says this was the last time he'd clean it.
event.old_friend.title: An Old Friend
event.orb_rain.body:
A meteor streaks across the night sky. Not a meteor — somebody's warehouse has blown up in the air.
The field beside the road is littered with glowing orbs; some are still rolling toward the ditch.
Further off, a bigger one is slowly rolling away, trailing light.
event.orb_rain.res.big: The Nodes chase the brightest ones across half the field. They come back at dawn with a gold one and a white one.
event.orb_rain.res.chase_lost: The orb rolls into the ditch and its light goes out. There's nothing at the bottom.
event.orb_rain.res.chase_orb: The orb stops at the edge of the ditch, as if waiting for you. Seven colors shine out from inside it.
event.orb_rain.res.near: Three blue orbs, still warm from the fall.
event.orb_rain.title: Orb Rain
event.quiet_street.body:
The truck rolls down a burned-out shopping street.
Shutters hang half open and signs creak in the wind. Other than that, there is nothing.
event.quiet_street.title: A Quiet Street
event.spoiled_supplies.body:
When the cargo door opens, a sour smell rolls out.
One of the workshop's sealed canisters has cracked somewhere along the way. Several lie on the floor smoking, and what spilled is still creeping outward.
event.spoiled_supplies.opt.sort: Take the time to sort it.
event.spoiled_supplies.res.dump: Half of your most plentiful material goes over the side. The floor comes clean.
event.spoiled_supplies.res.ignore: In the night there's a muffled thump from the cargo box. In the morning, one wall bulges outward.
event.spoiled_supplies.res.sort: The Nodes check every canister and throw out the spoiled share of each. It's dark before they finish.
event.spoiled_supplies.title: Spoiled Supplies
event.toll_gate.body:
Two wrecks across the road and a row of sandbags: the way is blocked.
A searchlight snaps on behind the sandbags, too bright to look at. Nobody shows themselves; a voice calls out: leave something, and you pass.
They don't want a fight. They don't need one.
event.toll_gate.res.force: The truck rams the wrecks aside, leaving a deep dent in the bonnet. Weaving around the scattered debris costs more time.
event.toll_gate.res.hand_weapon: A weapon from the armory goes over the sandbags. Someone behind the searchlight whistles.
event.toll_gate.res.pay: A bag of coins goes out the window. The searchlight dies and the sandbags part just wide enough.
event.toll_gate.res.turn: You turn around and take the long way. The searchlight follows you for a long while.
event.toll_gate.title: The Toll Gate
event.wandering_mechanic.body:
A pickup modified past recognition sits by the road; the blue flicker of a welding torch plays over its roof.
The welder lifts her mask, looks the truck over, and sighs.
"It's a miracle this thing still runs."
event.wandering_mechanic.res.join: She looks at her pickup, then at the truck, hooks the torch on her belt and climbs into the cargo box.
event.wandering_mechanic.res.overhaul: She works through the night. By morning the truck is sturdier than it was from the factory, with an extra ring of bracing welded onto the frame.
event.wandering_mechanic.res.part: She digs a part out of the pickup's bed, slaps the dust off and hands it over.
event.wandering_mechanic.title: The Wandering Mechanic
