keyword_desc.amplify: A numeric parameter that triggers and other effects can read.
keyword_desc.awakening: Inactive until its task is completed; then it awakens for the rest of the battle.
keyword_desc.basic: No cooldown or charge limit: fires whenever its trigger fires.
keyword_desc.chant: Channel for N seconds (cannot move or attack; stun interrupts), then release. Longer chant, stronger effect.
keyword_desc.charged: Holds N charges; each use spends one and they recover over the cooldown.
keyword_desc.crit: The effect can crit using the source's crit chance and crit damage.
keyword_desc.eternal: Values that would normally reset when the battle ends are unaffected and carry over between battles.
keyword_desc.learning: Each time this effect triggers it adds one learning count. Cleared when the battle ends.
keyword_desc.limited: Only fires when its condition (a specific kind of event) is met.
keyword_desc.multi_attack: When the trigger supplies several targets, this ability affects the first N; without it only the first target is used.
keyword_desc.performance: The effect applies when the chant starts (not when it ends) and is sustained throughout the chant. Picks the most important target on its own — a buff or a debuff; the same effect can't be used twice in a row. Options: ① the ally with the highest attack / ability power: attack or ability power boost (whichever is better); ② the enemy with the lowest health: sustained 【Burning】; ③ the enemy with the most damage dealt this battle: sustained 【Chill】 (one more each second); ④ the ally with the lowest health ratio: sustained 【Regeneration】 (one more each second); ⑤ an enemy melee unit close to your backline: knocked back and kept slowed; ⑥ the enemy healed the most this battle: sustained healing reduction; ⑦ the enemy that took the most damage this battle: sustained armor and magic resist reduction.
keyword_desc.pursuit: After firing, immediately repeat the normal attack N more times (copies never chain pursuit).
keyword_desc.splash: Applies 50% of the effect to every unit around the target (radius N×1.2 m, friend or foe).
keyword_desc.stacking: The status stacks up to N times.
keyword_desc.summon: Summons a unit next to the source, inheriting its star level.
keyword_desc.worlds: Roll 2d10, then: odd — all enemies swap places at random; even — all enemies get one random common debuff (Burning / Chill / Poison / Paralysis). Under 10 — small magic damage (attack + ability power) to all enemies; 10 or more — medium physical normal-attack damage; 20 or more — heavy true normal-attack damage. If the two dice add up to 2: everyone swaps places, everyone gets a random common debuff, and everyone takes heavy magic damage, friend or foe.
material.blue.desc: Negentropy bottled like mineral water. In the workshop it pulls the result toward blue.
material.blue.name: Liquid Negentropy
material.green.desc: A seed in the middle of sprouting. In the workshop it pulls the result toward green.
material.green.name: Organic Matter
material.red.desc: A clump of fire that never goes out. In the workshop it pulls the result toward red.
material.red.name: Phlogiston
mod.anti_resist.name: Anti-Resistance Jamming
mod.arcane_basics.name: Arcane Fundamentals
mod.arcane_growth.desc: In battle, codices (focus-weapon payloads) without [Learning] gain [Learning]. Each learning count raises the trigger value a codex receives by 10%.
mod.arcane_growth.name: Arcane Growth Technique
mod.cast_guard.desc: 50% of the damage a chanting Node takes is shared equally by the other Nodes (the shared part ignores armor, shields and reductions).
mod.cast_guard.name: Targeted Protection
mod.hardened_alloy.desc: All [b]melee[/b] Nodes take 15% less damage (final reduction).
mod.hardened_alloy.name: Hardened Alloy
mod.light_armor.name: Lightened Armor
mod.pearl_field.desc: [Critical]. Every non-periodic damage dealt by Nodes can critically strike; damage that already could may crit a second time.
mod.pearl_field.name: Pearlescent Field
mod.potent_dose.desc: At the start of battle and every 3 s after, each Node's next [Stacking] status application adds one extra stack.
mod.potent_dose.name: Potent Dose
mod.powder_boost.name: Extra Powder
mod.sharp_arms.desc: Every weapon's normal-attack multiplier rises by a third of its base value (normal-attack trigger values ×4/3).
mod.sharp_arms.name: Honed Arms
mod.time_management.desc: The [Stacking] count of every Node passive and weapon effect rises by 25% (rounded down, at least +1).
mod.time_management.name: Time Management
mod.truck_free.desc:
While preparing, the truck can [b]move[/b] or [b]rotate[/b] inside the initial deploy zone (9 × 6); the zone [b]stays put[/b], so the truck can park on one side and leave the rest to your Nodes (Nodes under the truck step aside).
Drag the truck to move it; press [b]T[/b] or hit Rotate Truck to turn it 90°.
mod.truck_free.name: Free Chassis
mod.truck_wide.desc: The truck stays parked in the middle, but the initial deploy zone grows by [b]one row on every side[/b] (11 × 8, 82 cells).
mod.truck_wide.name: Wider Ground
mod.truck_zone.desc:
While preparing, the truck can [b]move[/b] or [b]rotate[/b] inside the initial deploy zone (9 × 6); the deploy zone [b]moves and rotates with it[/b], Nodes included (the truck keeps its place inside the zone).
Drag the truck to move it; press [b]T[/b] or hit Rotate Truck to turn it 90°.
mod.truck_zone.name: Mobile Workshop
mod.weapon_calibration.desc: All [b]ranged[/b] Nodes gain +25% critical chance and +25% critical damage.
mod.weapon_calibration.name: Weapon Calibration
part.jerrycan.name: Jerry Can
part.offroad_tire.desc: Jump in a straight line to a node up to 2 grid points away (over unfinished nodes, even without a road). Costs 1 action point.
part.offroad_tire.name: Off-road Tires
part.scout_drone.desc: Reveal every node within 2 grid points of the truck.
part.scout_drone.name: Scout Drone
part.spring_jack.desc: Jump to any node in the 8 surrounding grid points (diagonals too). Costs 1 action point.
part.spring_jack.name: Hydraulic Jack
status.ancient_awake.desc: Can't be dispelled. Woke from petrification with extra ability power and attack.
status.armor_crack.desc: Can be dispelled. -20 armor and magic resist per stack.
status.bad_luck.desc: Can be dispelled. Takes more damage.
status.battle_sense.desc: Dispellable, doesn't stack, lasts 3 s. Grants 1% normal-attack dodge chance per 10 points of trigger value.
status.bleed.desc: Stacks, dispellable, lasts 10 s, a debuff. Each stack deals physical damage over time every 0.25 s and heals the applier for the final damage dealt.
status.blight_venom.desc: Can be dispelled. Takes magic damage every second per stack.
status.blood_crack.desc: Stacks, dispellable, a debuff. Each stack adds 2 (flat) to every tick of damage over time taken.
status.blood_feast.desc: Stacks, can't be dispelled, lasts forever. Each stack grants 4% damage-over-time amplification and 3 flat damage reduction.
status.blood_rite.desc: Can't be dispelled. Takes true damage every second and can't be healed; stuns from this team last longer.
status.bloodlust.desc: Stacks, can't be dispelled, lasts forever. Whenever the holder deals or takes non-DoT damage, each stack gives the other side a stack of 【Bleeding】.
status.brave_dream.desc: Can't be dispelled, lasts forever. Immune to debuffs; stat-boosting statuses from teammates are multiplied.
status.brave_future.desc: Can't be dispelled, lasts forever. The stat boosts Node Brave left behind when she fell (everything she held, added together).
status.chill.desc: Each application is separate; dispellable; a debuff. Each lowers attack speed by 10%. When the chill on a unit adds up to more than 40%, all of it is consumed and becomes 【Frozen】 for 5 s.
status.chord_resonance.desc: Can be dispelled. More attack speed.
status.commando_mark.desc: Can't be dispelled, doesn't stack, a debuff. Damage it takes gets extra damage amplification. After 3 s, the ranged ally with the highest attack on Node Commando's side fires a free normal-attack shot at it, which consumes the mark on hit.
status.crescendo.desc: Can't be dispelled; kept between battles. Each stack speeds "every few seconds" timers by 3%.
status.crystal_wall.desc: Can be dispelled. Takes less damage.
status.cyan_tide.desc: Stacks, lasts forever. Each stack raises attack speed and ability power.
status.death_wish.desc: Normal attacks that hit an ally heal a small share of its max health instead.
status.despair.desc: Can be dispelled. Magic damage per stack each second; slower attacks and timers.
status.dragon_ember.desc: While the Ember of the Dragon is on the field: ember tiles never go out; all Burning removes max health each second instead; she is immune to Burning.
status.dream_amp.desc: Dispellable. Damage amplification efficacy up: damage amplification × (1 + efficacy).
status.dream_sink.desc: Dispellable, a debuff. Damage reduction efficacy up: damage reduction × (1 + efficacy) — when it's negative (Enthralled) it gets even more negative.
status.edge_rally.desc: Can be dispelled. +6% attack and +6% attack speed per stack.
status.elation.desc: Can be dispelled. Heals per stack each second; faster attacks and timers.
status.elite_vanity.desc: Stacks, but the effect doesn't (1 stack = 3 stacks; stacks only track dispel progress). Dispellable, at most 1 stack per dispel; ends when all 3 are gone. Lasts 20 s. Doubles its size, max health, attack, armor and magic resist; takes 50% less damage and deals 100% more; normal attacks become a dragon breath that hits every enemy on a 2 m wide ray, aimed to burn as many as possible. (Without Vanity it claws a single target.)
status.ember_wither.desc: Max health burned away by the Ember of the Dragon's fire (gone for the rest of this battle).
status.exposed.desc: Can be dispelled. Takes 15% more damage.
status.focus_breath.desc: Stacks, can't be dispelled, lasts forever. Each stack grants crit chance (Node Sniper: crit chance beyond 100% becomes twice as much crit damage). Cleared entirely when a melee enemy can reach her.
status.form_lion.desc: Can't be dispelled. Attacks don't depend on the weapon: melee claws, scaling with max health, with Pursuit.
status.form_spider.desc: Can't be dispelled. Attacks don't depend on the weapon: venomous fangs; hits apply Poison.
status.form_toad.desc: Can't be dispelled. Attacks don't depend on the weapon: extra armor and magic resistance; attacks bind the target with a tongue.
status.frozen.desc: Doesn't stack; dispellable; a debuff. Works like a stun. Elites / bosses don't recover from it faster, but each freeze a unit takes in a battle lasts half as long as the last (5 → 2.5 → 1.25 s…); re-applying adds to the duration.
status.funeral.desc: Stacks, can't be dispelled, a debuff. When full: common monsters and nodes die at once without on-death effects; elites / bosses lose part of their max health and the stacks are spent.
status.funeral_scar.desc: Can't be dispelled. Max health lost to full Funeral stacks (cumulative).
status.g10_ebb.desc: Can be dispelled. Less attack speed and move speed.
status.g10_feast.desc: Can be dispelled. Lasts the battle; more attack and physical lifesteal per stack.
status.g10_flow.desc: Can be dispelled. More attack speed and move speed.
status.g10_lament.desc: Can be dispelled. Less attack speed.
status.g10_nocturne.desc: Can be dispelled. More attack speed and healing received.
status.g10_overclock.desc: Can be dispelled. More haste per stack: every-x-seconds passives, triggers and cooldowns all tick faster.
status.g10_sprout.desc: Can be dispelled. Lasts the battle; more attack and max health per stack.
status.g10_sweet_dew.desc: Can be dispelled. More healing received; regenerates health every second.
status.g10_viper_coil.desc: Can be dispelled. Lasts the battle; more attack and attack speed per stack.
status.g10_viper_venom.desc: Can be dispelled. Takes magic damage every second per stack.
status.g10_wither.desc: Can be dispelled. Less attack and less healing received.
status.g5_flare_mark.desc: Can be dispelled. Takes more damage.
status.g5_gale.desc: Can be dispelled. Stacks, lasts the battle: each stack raises attack speed and haste and shortens reload time.
status.g5_honey.desc: Can be dispelled. Stacks: each stack raises attack and attack speed.
status.g5_thorn_bind.desc: Can be dispelled. Can't move or make normal attacks.
status.g5_venom.desc: Can be dispelled. Stacks: each stack deals magic damage every second.
status.g6_bloodlet.desc: Each one is separate. Can be dispelled. Takes physical damage every second.
status.g6_headwind.desc: Can be dispelled. Less attack speed and move speed.
status.g6_hexline.desc: Can be dispelled. Normal attacks' physical damage carries extra magic damage; more ability power.
status.g6_momentum.desc: Can be dispelled. More attack per stack.
status.g6_tailwind.desc: Can be dispelled. More attack speed and move speed.
status.g6_transfused.desc: Can be dispelled. More healing received and more attack.
status.g8_dazzled.desc: Can be dispelled. Less attack speed and move speed.
status.g8_festival.desc: Can be dispelled. More attack and attack speed.
status.g8_neurotoxin.desc: Can be dispelled. Stacks: each stack lowers attack speed and raises damage taken.
status.g8_papercut.desc: Can be dispelled. Stacks: each stack raises damage taken.
status.g8_podshell.desc: Can be dispelled. Takes less damage.
status.g8_riveted.desc: Can be dispelled. Stacks, lasts the battle: each stack raises armor and magic resistance.
status.g8_stimulant.desc: Can be dispelled. More attack speed and healing received.
status.g8_tinnitus.desc: Can be dispelled. Less attack speed.
status.g9_dawnlight.desc: Can be dispelled. More damage reduction and attack.
status.g9_laurel.desc: Can't be dispelled; lasts the battle. More attack and physical lifesteal per stack.
status.g9_star_ward.desc: Can be dispelled. More armor and magic resist.
status.g9_thorns.desc: Can be dispelled. Each stack adds a little to every normal-attack hit it takes.
status.good_luck.desc: Can be dispelled. More crit chance and attack speed.
status.infusion.desc: Stacks, dispellable, a debuff. When hit by a normal attack, consumes 1 stack: heals the attacker for 40, then deals that much magic damage to the holder.
status.intox.desc: Stacks, can't be dispelled, carries over between battles. Each stack lowers damage reduction and raises damage amplification.
status.keen_eye.desc: Can be dispelled. More crit chance and crit damage.
status.lightning_call.desc: Can't be dispelled. Normal attacks are chanted and release chain lightning.
status.lily_bloom.desc: Doesn't stack, can't be dispelled, lasts forever. Grants the full-stack 【Petal】 bonuses.
status.lily_petal.desc: Stacks, can't be dispelled, lasts forever. Each stack grants healing bonus; from 4 stacks it also grants max health, from 8 armor and magic resistance. Doesn't count while 【Bloom】 is up (Bloom already grants the full-stack bonuses).
status.lily_stamen.desc: Stacks, can't be dispelled, lasts forever. Normal-attack damage gains a final damage bonus equal to the healing bonus. A normal attack spends one: it becomes an extended sword / spear / cannon of light that hits a huge cone for several times the normal attack, and the damage dealt is shared out as healing among every wounded ally.
status.melancholy_drown.desc: Takes 50% less damage (while another ally is alive).
status.mistveil.desc: Can be dispelled. More normal-attack dodge, attack speed and attack.
status.money_bag.desc: Doesn't stack, can't be dispelled, lasts forever. Counts coins; every 2 s they may double or vanish; cashed in when the battle ends.
status.paralysis.desc: Doesn't stack, dispellable, a debuff. Takes more damage; has the same chance to be interrupted when a normal attack's wind-up completes.
status.petrified.desc: Can't be dispelled. A special stun: can't act, 80% damage reduction.
status.poison.desc: Applied separately each time, dispellable, a debuff. Takes magic damage every second.
status.potent_dose.desc: The next [Stacking] status you apply gains one extra stack, then this is spent.
status.pride_favor.desc: +30% attack, +30% attack speed, 20% less damage taken.
status.prism_shatter.desc: Can be dispelled. Less magic resist.
status.puppet_strings.desc: Can be dispelled. More attack and attack speed.
status.purple_charge.desc: Doesn't stack. The next normal attack adds magic damage based on (attack + ability power), then it's consumed.
status.regen.desc: Each application is separate; dispellable. Each heals 10 health per second (counted as the applier's healing).
status.requiem_soul.desc: Can't be dispelled. More max health; on death, deals part of its max health as magic damage to enemies within 2 m.
status.ribbon_cheer.desc: Can be dispelled. More attack and physical lifesteal per stack.
status.saber_momentum.desc: Can be dispelled. More attack speed per stack.
status.selfless_scar.desc: Can't be dispelled. Selfless cut away part of the max health.
status.sever_scar.desc: Can't be dispelled. Part of the max health has been cut away.
status.shadow_rot.desc: Dispellable, a debuff. Deals magic damage over time every 0.5 s for 2 s.
status.shadow_slay.desc: Dispellable, stacks, lasts forever. Normal-attack and skill damage carry 25% × trigger value magic damage over time per stack (dealt over 2 s).
status.shadow_veil.desc: Stacks, dispellable, lasts forever. While held, enemies can't target the holder unless it's the last legal target left. Each stack grants damage amplification on attacks from behind.
status.star_mark.desc: Can be dispelled. Takes more damage.
status.toad_bind.desc: Can't be dispelled. Bound to the toad: rooted, and both can only target each other.
status.true_dice.desc: His own odds are rolled twice, keeping the better one.
status.verdant_haste.desc: Dispellable, lasts forever. Attack speed up (adds up with each use).
status.verdict_mark.desc: Can be dispelled. Takes more damage.
status.verdict_ward.desc: Can be dispelled. Takes less damage.
status.yellow_edge.desc: Stacks, lasts forever. Each stack raises attack.

trait.faction_blue.desc: Blue trait (counts Blue, Purple, Cyan and Black nodes): ability power and haste — the holder's “every x s” effects and cooldowns run faster.
trait.faction_blue.name: Azure Cadence
trait.faction_cyan.desc: Cyan trait (counts Cyan and Black nodes; Cyan nodes also get Blue and Green): every few seconds the holder gains a stack of 【Cerulean Tide】 (attack speed and ability power, stacks, lasts forever).
trait.faction_cyan.name: Cerulean Tide
trait.faction_cyan.tier.2: every 3 s +1 stack: +3% attack speed, +3 AP, up to 6
trait.faction_cyan.tier.4: every 2 s +1 stack: +4% attack speed, +4 AP, up to 8; every 4 s, each of the holder's other stacking buffs gains +1 stack
trait.faction_green.desc: Green trait (counts Green, Yellow, Cyan and Black nodes): attack speed and stacking — 【Stacking】 statuses the holder applies gain an extra stack.
trait.faction_green.name: Verdant Bloom
trait.faction_green.tier.4: +20% attack speed; 【Stacking】 statuses applied gain +1 stack
trait.faction_green.tier.6: +40% attack speed; 【Stacking】 statuses applied gain +1 stack
trait.faction_purple.desc: Purple trait (counts Purple and Black nodes; Purple nodes also get Red and Blue): every few seconds the holder charges up, and its next normal attack adds magic damage based on (attack + ability power).
trait.faction_purple.name: Violet Surge
trait.faction_purple.tier.2: every 5 s: next normal attack adds (attack + AP) × 50% magic damage
trait.faction_purple.tier.4: every 3 s: next normal attack adds (attack + AP) × 80% magic damage
trait.faction_red.desc: Red trait (counts Red, Purple, Yellow and Black nodes): attack and normal-attack damage.
trait.faction_red.name: Crimson Edge
trait.faction_yellow.desc: Yellow trait (counts Yellow and Black nodes; Yellow nodes also get Red and Green): each normal-attack / skill hit adds a stack of 【Gilded Edge】 (more attack, stacks, lasts forever).
trait.faction_yellow.name: Gilded Edge

ui.terrain.ember.desc: Doesn't block. The first piece to step on it starts 【Burning】 for 5 s; then the embers go out for good.
ui.terrain.frost.desc: Doesn't block. Pieces standing in it (both sides) gain a 4.5 s 【Chill】 every second; linger and you freeze on the fifth second.
ui.terrain.ice.desc: Blocks its cells; no other effect. Tall ones also block line of sight and projectiles.
